name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage exploration company focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Salta Province of Argentina. The Diablillos project hosts a Measured & Indicated resource of approximately 248 million ounces of silver and 2.5 million ounces of gold (454 Moz AgEq), and has received approval under Argentina's RIGI large investment incentive program. The company is completing a Definitive Feasibility Study expected in Q2 2026, transitioning from advanced explorer toward developer.
